component.name: PoniaEmu
component.summary: Game launcher with a built-in emulator player

description.p: PoniaEmu is a game launcher with a built-in Libretro player (PoniaPlay), so you can play retro games without installing RetroArch. It lets you browse your game library and start games from one place, with a focus on customizability, embedded devices and high performance.
Its frontend, PoniaFE, is a Qt 6 port of Pegasus Frontend by Mátyás Mustoha. Themes and metadata files made for Pegasus keep working in PoniaEmu.

component.developer_name: Equuleus Works (based on Pegasus Frontend by Mátyás Mustoha)
